text: I asked ChatGPT and Scout for noise-cancelling headphones for flights, under four hundred. Both recommended the same pair. But only one told me where it's fifty bucks cheaper. ChatGPT gave me a range. Around three hundred to three-forty. Scout checks prices across Aussie stores. Two ninety-nine at Kogan. Fifty bucks cheaper than Myer, for the exact same headphones. Scout. Launching November sixteen.
